name: omega-hub
description: Prototype MCP server for an in-memory Omega tri-token economy simulation; no real chain, keys, services, or value.

tools.name: sov_mint
tools.description: Add simulated SOV units to an address in this process's in-memory ledger. Requires a positive amount and reason; no real chain or value is involved.

tools.name: sov_burn
tools.description: Remove simulated SOV units from an address in the in-memory ledger. Requires a positive amount and sufficient balance.

tools.name: sov_transfer
tools.description: Move simulated SOV units between addresses in the in-memory ledger. Requires a positive amount and sufficient sender balance.

tools.name: sov_snapshot
tools.description: Inspect current in-memory SOV balances, simulated supply, and version.

tools.name: use_issue
tools.description: Create a simulated, non-transferable proof-of-useful-work receipt. Requires a category, positive quantity, evidence commitment, and at least one claimed attestation.

tools.name: use_revoke
tools.description: Mark a simulated USE receipt revoked by ID with a reason; the audit event is append-only.

tools.name: use_snapshot
tools.description: Inspect simulated USE receipts and their claimed attestation counts.

tools.name: care_submit
tools.description: Create a proposed Proof-of-Care claim in memory. This does not verify evidence or grant a real service or benefit.

tools.name: care_attest
tools.description: Add a simulated CARE attestation. Two distinct verifier labels move the claim to final; this is not cryptographic or independent verification.

tools.name: care_appeal
tools.description: File an in-memory appeal on a CARE claim with at least one attestation.

tools.name: care_snapshot
tools.description: Inspect in-memory CARE claims, attestation counts, and open appeals.

tools.name: amity_entitle
tools.description: Create simulated AMITY units from a finalized CARE claim under a policy label. The claim must exist and the amount must be positive; no real value is issued.

tools.name: amity_transfer
tools.description: Move simulated AMITY units between addresses in memory. Requires a positive amount and sufficient sender balance.

tools.name: amity_snapshot
tools.description: Inspect in-memory AMITY balances, simulated supply, and entitlements.

tools.name: omega_mint
tools.description: Add simulated OMEGA units to an address with a reason and protocol version; no real token is issued.

tools.name: omega_lock
tools.description: Lock simulated OMEGA units for a positive duration in blocks; returns a prototype governance weight.

tools.name: omega_proposal
tools.description: Draft an in-memory governance proposal with a change set, simulation reference, and rollback plan.

tools.name: omega_vote
tools.description: Record a simulated vote on a proposal with voter, support flag, and positive weight.

tools.name: omega_snapshot
tools.description: Inspect in-memory OMEGA balances, simulated supply, locks, and proposals.

tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Current in-memory simulation snapshot across all planes, plus event count and next version.

tools.name: events_since
tools.description: Versioned audit events after a given version; payloads are not a complete state-replay log.

tools.name: full_event_log
tools.description: Inspect the append-only audit events emitted by this process; they are not a complete state-replay log.
